audit_of_record.what_it_is: An independent 12-axis audit of this concept, run read-only against the 2026-08-15 concept state. It ships AUDIT_REPORT.md, FINDINGS.json (167 surviving findings plus 20 refuted, each with evidence and a reproduction command), DECISION_CLASSIFICATION.json (all 107 packet decisions classified), CANONICAL_FIXTURE_CROSSCHECK.json, a port handoff with measured corrections, 15 re-runnable harness scripts, 27 probe result files and 80 screenshots.
audit_of_record.headline_verdict: Not ready to port; ready for one more iteration. 7 blockers, 51 majors, 38 register and evidence-integrity defects.
audit_of_record.why_this_register_changed: The audit found that this register asserted two different test results, deferred five owners to Plans files that do not exist, listed six commands as dispatched that are never dispatched, certified a hard-failure guardrail that measurement disproved, and declared no owner or retention for any of the five localStorage keys the concept writes.
audit_of_record.reader_instruction: Read AUDIT_REPORT.md sections 4, 8 and 12 before treating anything in reports/ as settled. This repair corrects the registers only; the concept-side defects the audit found are separate changes.

scope_override.standing_default_at_session_start: P:\.claude\CLAUDE.md (developer-level) restricted edits to Plans/**; its explicit-request exception list (AGENTS.md, .cursorrules, .claude/**, .cursor/**) did not include Concepts/**.
scope_override.provisional_authorization: The approving prompt and the plan's Scope section carried the user's in-prompt override for Concepts/usage-concepts/QwenUsageConcept/** only (same pattern as the 2026-08-11 Settings/Chat concept sessions). This was treated as provisional pending principal ratification.
scope_override.ratification: During review an advisor objected on hierarchy grounds. The repo principal then (a) ruled live in-session ('Ignore the CLAUDE.md. You are authorized. I am authorizing it.') and (b) amended P:\.claude\CLAUDE.md Scope line 4 to 'Allowed edits: Plans/** Concepts/**'. The amendment is the operative authorization; the in-prompt override and ruling were provisional steps superseded by it.
scope_override.agent_side_constraint: The agent never amended CLAUDE.md itself (the 'do not amend unless asked' notes were agent-side defaults, not claims about the principal's power); the principal made the amendment directly.
scope_override.no_precedent: In-prompt authorizations do not waive developer-level project context. Future out-of-scope work must escalate and obtain a CLAUDE.md amendment (or an explicit request to make one); absent that, sessions default to BLOCKED.

event_authority_boundary_2026_08_18.measured_from: Plans/Wiring_Matrix.production.json and Plans/DRY_Rules.md, both read-only to this concept
event_authority_boundary_2026_08_18.statement: The Usage command family declares no domain events in production wiring. All five usage rows - catalog.usage_refresh, catalog.usage_export, catalog.usage_forecast_request, catalog.nav_open_usage_subject and catalog.artifacts_show_in_usage - carry expected_event_types []. 160 of the matrix's 726 entries declare event types; no usage row is among them.
event_authority_boundary_2026_08_18.what_the_rows_declare_instead: effect_kind 'receipt'. catalog.usage_refresh spells it out: 'cmd.usage.refresh has no declared persisted event; dispatch must still record a no-persist command receipt or route/open disposition.'
event_authority_boundary_2026_08_18.denominator: Plans/DRY_Rules.md:2139, in 'Unresolved schema and Event Authority boundary' (:2132-2143): 'The Event Authority denominator remains UNKNOWN_OPEN. No event family is inferred, registered, or declared emitted from a service name in this registry.' Admitting a usage event family is an Event Authority adjudication. This register does not perform one and does not name a candidate family, because naming one would be the inference that clause forbids.
event_authority_boundary_2026_08_18.consequence: event_schema_impacts below, and everything in reports/event-schema-delta.json, are proposals against a receipt-and-projection contract with no wiring row to attach to. They are not evidence that a usage event family exists.

The scope picker now dispatches nothing at all, and the harness case 'closure changing the page scope dispatches no command' holds it there.

test_results: reports/visual-interaction-test-report.json records 108 cases, 108 pass, 0 fail, exit 0, from a run at 2026-08-18T14:09:40.337Z against the concept as it stood at that moment. This is the measured state and it supersedes every earlier count quoted in this file.

The 108 cases split: 40 theme-by-width matrix loads (8 themes x 5 widths), 18 closure guards, 18 fixture checks, 13 hard-failure guards, 7 new-behaviour checks, 6 interaction flows, 3 correction checks, 1 new-behaviour console check, 1 hard-failure console check, 1 context-details check.

The 18 closure guards are new on 2026-08-18 and exist because roughly fifty findings were closed across two remediation passes with almost no test behind them, and twice a closed thing silently broke - a Ledger column that collapsed to 0px at 360-520 and took 98 strings with it, and a duplicate element id. They guard: turn-card aggregation (work-item totals, disjoint roles, multi-family routes), scope-footer arithmetic, deep-link destination identity against Plans/settings_inventory.json, the model scope level, the CBP-027 probe vocabulary and its credits MUST_NOT set, time-kind coverage on every run, the command contract (a scope change dispatches nothing; run inspector on cmd.nav.open_subject, attempt inspector on cmd.nav.open_usage_subject), removed-source history under a bucket filter, zero-width and unrecoverable truncation at 360 and 520, duplicate ids across every room and overlay, tooltip enum hygiene, and unknown-never-zero read from rendered percentages.

All 18 closure cases and the three cases rewritten in the same pass were negative-controlled: the thing each guards was broken in a scratch copy of the concept, the case was confirmed red, and the copy was discarded. A case that has never been seen to fail is not a guard.

What the harness does not cover is stated in README.md under 'What the harness does not cover'. It is a real gate for what it tests and silent about part of the surface; the dead-controls half of packet 05's ninth hard failure is the largest deliberate gap and is named in u11-verify.mjs itself.
